✨ MeshSense | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring and visualizing the health and status of Meshtastic mesh networks.
✨ Key Features: • Monitors Meshtastic network health • Maps and graphically displays network stats • Connects via Bluetooth or WiFi • Provides node information, signal reports, and trace routes • Supports headless usage via command-line flags and environment variables
📖 Summary: MeshSense is an open-source application written in TypeScript that monitors, maps, and graphically displays the vital statistics of Meshtastic mesh networks. It connects via Bluetooth or WiFi to provide insights into network health, including connected nodes, signal reports, and trace routes.
